(i) we propose two novel queueing network models for DAG scheduling on multiple servers; (ii) we design a provably efficient scheduling policy for DAG scheduling based on the queueing network models; and (iii) we compare the delay performance between the queueing networks.

(1) we propose a new queueing model for the DAG scheduling problem that enables us to design provable efficient policies; (2) we prove that a Max-Weight policy is throughput-optimal in our queueing model; (3) we characterize delay performances of two different queueing networks that model the DAG scheduling problem, via a novel analysis.
